stories.story_fr: La hausse de production dans le Golfe d'Amerique et la solide performance de bpx Energy (onshore US) ont compense les perturbations au Moyen-Orient et une cession en mer du Nord, maintenant la production globalement stable.
stories.story_en: Higher production in the Gulf of America and strong bpx Energy (US onshore) performance offset Middle East disruptions and a North Sea divestment, keeping production broadly flat.
stories.signal: Production amont resiliente malgre les perturbations
stories.quote: reported production broadly flat as higher production in the Gulf of America and strong performance in bpx Energy offset the impact of disruptions in the Middle East and a North Sea divestment at the end of 2025

stories.story_fr: La contribution du trading petrolier au T1 2026 a ete qualifiee d'exceptionnelle, portant le profit RC sous-jacent a 3,2 Md$ contre 1,5 Md$ au trimestre precedent.
stories.story_en: Q1 2026 oil trading contribution was described as exceptional, lifting underlying RC profit to $3.2bn from $1.5bn the prior quarter.
stories.quote: the underlying result reflects exceptional oil trading contribution and stronger midstream performance

stories.story_fr: L'accord de cession de la raffinerie de Gelsenkirchen relevera l'objectif de reduction structurelle des couts de 1 Md$, a 6,5-7,5 Md$ d'ici 2027, a l'achevement de la transaction.
stories.story_en: The agreed sale of the Gelsenkirchen refinery will raise bp's structural cost reduction target by $1bn to $6.5-7.5bn by 2027 on completion.
stories.quote: On transaction completion, our structural cost reduction* target will increase by $1 billion to $6.5-7.5 billion by 2027

stories.story_fr: bp a annonce une decouverte significative de gaz et condensat au large de l'Egypte (puits Denise W-1, concession Temsah) et une decision finale d'investissement sur le champ gazier Harmattan via la JV Arcius.
stories.story_en: bp announced a significant gas and condensate discovery offshore Egypt (Denise W-1 well, Temsah Concession) and an FID on the Harmattan gas field via the Arcius JV.
stories.quote: In April bp announced a significant gas and condensate discovery offshore Egypt following the successful drilling of the Denise W-1 exploration well in the Temsah Concession

stories.story_fr: Grace au renforcement du bilan, bp prevoit de reduire son capital hybride perpetuel d'environ 4,3 Md$, a environ 9 Md$ d'ici fin 2027.
stories.story_en: On the back of a stronger balance sheet, bp plans to cut perpetual hybrid bond capital by about $4.3bn to roughly $9bn by end 2027.
stories.quote: bp now plans to reduce its perpetual hybrid bond capital to approximately $9 billion ... This $4.3 billion reduction
